notes:
v1.0.35 - five changes in one release:
1) OBS DEEP-FIX (game-side): the bundled FPS Boost mod now audits the capture-hook
   path - no anti-hook hardening anywhere, borderless windowed fullscreen preferred
   (OBS Game Capture hooks the fast shared-GPU-texture path instead of falling back
   to slow Display Capture), and the present/swap path stays standard. Logs whether
   a capture tool is detected (OBS/Discord) so a recording-session FPS comparison
   can be measured.
2) NO MORE "NOT RESPONDING" + FASTER LOADS (game-side): resource-pack/shader reloads
   keep the window pumping messages and rendering a loading screen the whole time
   (LoadingBoost). Change 2 of the asset-pipeline speed pass is implemented for real:
   a NEW processed-output decode cache (LoadCache) keyed by the SHA-256 of the exact
   input bytes - identical bytes always decode identically, so every cache hit is
   pixel-identical by construction, with zero invalidation logic. Repeat loads of
   the same pack skip the whole STB decode and restore pixels with one bulk buffer
   copy (in-memory LRU + on-disk tier under gameDir/reimagined-cache, both bounded,
   LRU evicted; fully guarded - a failure just falls back to the vanilla decode).
3) SOUND SYSTEM: single Aurora theme (Crystal and Zen removed, theme picker deleted -
   sound is just on/off now), two new short cues - a gentle chime when an update is
   available and a satisfying completion sound on any install/download finishing
   (mod install, update install, profile ready, backups) - and every existing sound
   normalized to a soft, non-fatiguing loudness that respects the master volume.
4) SIDEBAR: the big REIMAGINED LAUNCHER wordmark above MAIN is gone (expanded and
   collapsed) - the sidebar starts clean with the MAIN section.
5) UPDATE BUTTON: the text button under Account is now a minimal down-arrow icon
   (same click = same update flow) with a smooth hover tooltip showing
   "Update available: vX.X.X" from the real update check.
Bundled FPS Boost upgraded to 1.0.11 (auto-upgraded for every profile on next launch).
